parameters.query:
SELECT j.id, j.company, j.title, j.location, j.remote, j.url,
       j.description, j.salary, j.match_score, j.technical_score,
       j.experience_score, j.strengths, j.missing_skills, j.risks, j.ai_reasoning,
       j.skills as job_skills
FROM jobs j
LEFT JOIN applications a ON a.job_id = j.id
WHERE j.status = 'MATCHED'
  AND j.match_score >= {{ $env.MIN_MATCH_SCORE || 70 }}
  AND a.id IS NULL
ORDER BY j.match_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

parameters.jsCode:
// Build application generation prompt
const job = $json;

const baseCV = `
Ghaith Oueslati — DevSecOps & Backend Engineer, graduating ESPRIT 2026

EXPERIENCE:
1. SeekMake (Jan 2026-Present): DevSecOps & Backend Engineer
   - Cut security triage 60% integrating Gemini API into CI/CD (OWASP ZAP + Trivy)
   - Reduced API latency 83% via MongoDB aggregation optimization + caching
   - Built AI test-generation agent (5,200+ lines, Vertex AI, 75%+ test coverage)
   - Migrated 38+ workflows GitHub Actions → GitLab CI/CD
   - Migrated 8/12 microservices GCP Cloud Run → Azure Container Apps
   - Configured Azure Front Door for production routing
   - 88% first-submission PR rate in 6-engineer Agile team

2. Cube IT (Jun 2025-Present): Mobile Developer Intern
   - Improved travel time accuracy 15% integrating mapping APIs (Flutter transport app)
   - Built/tested booking + payment gateway features (Flutter + Spring Boot)

3. Barmej Tech (Jun-Aug 2024): Fullstack Developer Intern
   - Boosted backend performance 30% via SQL optimization + caching
   - Delivered HR leave-tracking with REST APIs + JWT auth

SKILLS:
- Languages: JS/TS, Python, Java, C#, SQL
- Frameworks: NestJS, Spring Boot, React, Angular, Flutter, Django
- Cloud: AWS (EC2, Lambda), Azure (Container Apps, Front Door, ACR), GCP (Cloud Run)
- DevOps: Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins
- Security: OWASP ZAP, Trivy, SonarQube, SAST, DAST
- DBs: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL
- Other: Grafana, Vertex AI, Gemini API, Keycloak, JWT, Microservices

LANGUAGES: Arabic (native), French (professional), English (professional), Italian (B2)
`;

const strengths = JSON.stringify(job.strengths || []);
const missing = JSON.stringify(job.missing_skills || []);

const prompt = `You are a professional CV writer. Generate a customized job application package for this candidate.

CANDIDATE BASE PROFILE:
${baseCV}

TARGET JOB:
Title: ${job.title}
Company: ${job.company}
Location: ${job.location}
Remote: ${job.remote ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
Match Score: ${job.match_score}%
Key Strengths for this role: ${strengths}
Job Description (summary):
${(job.description || '').substring(0, 3000)}

GENERATE the following. Return ONLY valid JSON:

RULES:
- NEVER invent technologies, metrics, projects, certifications, or experience not in the base profile
- You MAY reorder skills, reword bullets, emphasize relevant experience
- Cover note: max 3 sentences. Be specific to this company/role. No generic AI text.
- Bullets should be impactful and quantified where the base CV has metrics

{
  "professional_summary": "3-4 sentence summary tailored to this specific role",
  "recommended_bullets": [
    "Bullet 1 from actual experience, reworded for this role",
    "Bullet 2",
    "Bullet 3",
    "Bullet 4 (optional)",
    "Bullet 5 (optional)"
  ],
  "skills_ordering": ["Most relevant skills first", "..."],
  "cover_note": "Single paragraph, max 3 sentences, specific to this company and role"
}`;

return [{ json: { ...job, app_prompt: prompt } }];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO applications (
  job_id, match_score, custom_summary, custom_bullets,
  skills_ordering, cover_note, status
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.job_id }}'::uuid,
  {{ $json.match_score }},
  '{{ $json.custom_summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.custom_bullets || []) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.skills_ordering || []) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.cover_note.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'READY'
)
ON CONFLICT (job_id) DO UPDATE SET
  custom_summary = EXCLUDED.custom_summary,
  custom_bullets = EXCLUDED.custom_bullets,
  skills_ordering = EXCLUDED.skills_ordering,
  cover_note = EXCLUDED.cover_note,
  status = 'READY',
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, job_id, status;

UPDATE applications SET
  cv_markdown_path = '{{ $json.cv_markdown_path }}',
  status = 'READY',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE job_id = '{{ $json.job_id }}'::uuid;
